answer: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=');

SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id FROM connected c JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n') OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) FROM atom a WHERE a.element IN ('i','s') AND a.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-');

SELECT a.element FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';
